title: Source-freshness completion path through the agent words, and matrix traceability with the missing B23 and B25 cases
outcome: Source-freshness completion path through the agent words, and matrix traceability with the missing B23 and B25 cases
acceptance: done accepts --source-fingerprint on CLI and MCP; under require_source_freshness a matching fingerprint seals, a missing one is refused with a remedy naming that flag, a changed one is refused as stale source, and ordinary show reports the source check as pending at read instead of stale

every boundary-matrix comment in the acceptance-evaluation tests names the document's row, and new tests cover B23 (reopen into a new run refuses MissingAcceptanceEvaluation) and B25 (done --link under an evaluated policy is refused with the run feed head unchanged)

completion.summary: done --source-fingerprint on CLI and MCP (schema key list in mcp-dogfood updated); reads treat an unmeasured source as pending (show prints the recorded fingerprint as checked at done) while completion refuses missing or different fingerprints with source, without hiding revision/policy/identity reasons; the stale(source) remedy names the flag. Matrix comments in tests.rs relabeled to the doc rows; B23 (reopen -> Missing, fresh record on the new run) and B25 (done --link refused, feed head unchanged) added and disclosed as pins that already passed at RED time. Docs F4, agent surface, B23-B25 corrected, B42. RED logs/08, GREEN logs/11 and 12.
